notes: Same access route as Bestsellers/Clearance (direct HTTP fetch, no block). No New-Arrivals link exists anywhere in the live header menu, footer, or category-accordion tree (/pages/category_list) -- checked the full extracted menu JSON and the rendered homepage HTML (11MB) for 新着/新商品/新作/New Arrival/New In, zero matches. All candidates below were found only via sitemap_collections_1/2.xml (3089 URLs enumerated) and validated by opening each page + exhaustive products.json pagination + product-ID-set overlap checks against the corresponding base department/catalogue. EXCLUDED as not genuinely curated 'recently added' listings, because each is essentially the entire base scope re-sorted rather than a distinct new-arrivals subset: new_items (6283 products) is a 99.8% subset of the store's entire 6297-product catalogue (verified via /collections/all/products.json exhaustive pagination: overlap=6283, catalogue-only=14, new_items-only=0); new-all (4864) is likewise ~77% of the whole catalogue; new-kitchen (1707) is a 99% subset of the 'kitchen' department (1724, overlap=1707, kitchen-only=17, new-kitchen-only=0); new-interior (704) overlaps 637/645 (99%) of the 'interior_goods' department while adding 67 items from elsewhere. Also checked and excluded new-bath (778), new-furniture (829), new-fabric (1086), new-fashion (674) on the same pattern (each department's 'new-<dept>' handle sized at 95-100% of that department). None of this new-* family is linked from any live nav either -- all sitemap-only orphans. KEPT: /collections/newitem (English page title literally 'New Items', 7 products, distinct handle from the excluded new_items) is a small, genuinely scoped listing, not a near-total department/catalogue alias -- recorded below with a flag for its orphan/no-nav-linkage status. This is a correct, evidence-based investigation of a real absence-from-nav situation, not a failure to look: sitemap, header menu, footer, category tree, and homepage were all checked, plus direct probes of English URL-shape candidates (new-arrivals, new-in, just-in, whats-new -> all HTTP 404).
